apps.name: Calendar
apps.label: Calendar
apps.description: Your upcoming events, read-only. Connect Google, Outlook or iCloud in a couple of clicks, or paste any shared calendar link. Add as many as you like, star the one that should open first, or see them all together.

title.labelOption: Show today's next event on the button

google.name: Google Calendar
steps: Sign in with your Google account.
On the left, under “Settings for my calendars”, click the calendar you want.
Scroll down to “Integrate calendar” and click the eye next to “Secret address in iCal format”.

outlook.name: Outlook
steps: Sign in with your Microsoft account.
Under “Publish a calendar”, pick your calendar and “Can view all details”, then click Publish.
If it was already published, the links show straight away.

icloud.name: iCloud Calendar
steps: Sign in with your Apple Account (you may need to approve it on your iPhone).
In the list of calendars, click the share icon next to the one you want.
Tick “Public Calendar”. Only people with the link can see it.
